description: This file defines a Java interface for serializing custom data from business events within the Fineract project. It specifies methods for serializing event data into byte buffers and retrieving serializer keys.

classes.name: ExternalEventCustomDataSerializer
classes.description: A Java interface for serializing custom data from BusinessEvent objects into ByteBuffer and retrieving associated keys.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the custom data from a BusinessEvent into a ByteBuffer.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key used to identify this serializer's data in the custom data map.
